# @fyit/crouton-ai

> AI integration with Anthropic Claude and OpenAI

AI hint: use when app has AI/LLM features or chat

## Components

- `AIPageGenerator`: Modal that generates page content with AI for one or more locales
- `AITranslateButton`: Translate button that calls the AI translation API and emits the result
